pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Hapón (Haponés: 日本, Nippon or Nihon,[nb 1] yan gi fotmåt 日本国, Nihonkoku)[nb 2] un nasión na isla gi iya Asia.
pairs.english: Japan (Japanese: 日本, Nippon or Nihon,[nb 1] and formally 日本国, Nihonkoku)[nb 2] is an island country in East Asia.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Såsaonao Hapón gi i mafanana'an Aniyon Guåfi (Englés: Ring of Fire), ya kumonsiste nu 14,125 na isla, ya i singko prinsipåt na isla Hokkaido, Honshu (the "mainland"), Shikoku, Kyushu, yan Okinawa.
pairs.english: It is situated in the northwest Pacific Ocean and is bordered on the west by the Sea of Japan, extending from the Sea of Okhotsk in the north toward the East China Sea, Philippine Sea, and Taiwan in the south. Japan is a part of the Ring of Fire, and spans an archipelago of 14,125 islands, with the five main islands being Hokkaido, Honshu (the "mainland"), Shikoku, Kyushu, and Okinawa.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tokyo i kapitåt Hapón yan i mas dångkulu na siudåt, tinattitiyi ni Yokohama, Osaka, Nagoya, Sapporo, Fukuoka, Kobe yan Kyoto.
pairs.english: Tokyo is the nation's capital and largest city, followed by Yokohama, Osaka, Nagoya, Sapporo, Fukuoka, Kobe, and Kyoto.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Hapón i mina' onse mas mítaotao na nasión gi enteru mundo, yan lokkue' unu gi i mas motmot taotao.
pairs.english: Japan is the eleventh most populous country in the world, as well as one of the most densely populated.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Kasi tres-kuåtto gi i tirenon i tano' sumabåna, ya ayu muna' manggaige i populasión gi kanifes na lugåt gi uriya.
pairs.english: About three-fourths of the country's terrain is mountainous, concentrating its highly urbanized population on narrow coastal plains. Japan is divided into 47 administrative prefectures and eight traditional regions.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Madibidi Hapón entre 47 na distrito, pat "prefecture" gi fino'Englés, yan ochu na lugåt tradisionåt.
pairs.english: The Greater Tokyo Area is the most populous metropolitan area in the world. Japan has the world's highest life expectancy, though it is experiencing a population decline.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: A, pat a, i fine'nina na letra yan i fine'nina na letra gi i alfabeton Latin, [ 1 ] [2] ma'usa gi i modernu na alfabeton Ingles, yan otro siha gi enteru mundo.
pairs.english: A, or a, is the first letter and the first vowel letter of the Latin alphabet,[1][2] used in the modern English alphabet, and others worldwide.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I na'an-ña gi fino' Engles a (ma'a'agang /ˈ eɪ / AY ), plural aes .[nb 1][2]
pairs.english: Its name in English is a (pronounced /ˈeɪ/ AY), plural aes.[nb 1][2]

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parehu i fina'tinas-ña yan i letra alpha gi antigu na Griegu, ni' ginen este na tinige'. [3] I letra ni' takkilo' ha konsiste i dos na bandan triångko ni' manma'a'ñao, ya ma'a'ñao gi i talo' ni' un båndan åpaka'.
pairs.english: It is similar in shape to the Ancient Greek letter alpha, from which it derives.[3] The uppercase version consists of the two slanting sides of a triangle, crossed in the middle by a horizontal bar.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I dikike' na letra ma tuge' gi unu gi dos na manera: i dos-eskalera | a | yan un-eskalera | ɑ | .
pairs.english: The lowercase version is often written in one of two forms: the double-storey |a| and single-storey |ɑ|.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I uttimo na tinige' ma'usa gi i tinige' yan i letra siha ni' ma'usa gi i letra siha, espesiåtmente i letra siha ni' para u ma taitai ni' famagu'on, yan ma sodda' lokkue' gi i italic type .
pairs.english: The latter is commonly used in handwriting and fonts based on it, especially fonts intended to be read by children, and is also found in italic type.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gi fino' Engles, a i artikulo ni' ti ma'aidentifika, yan i otro na manera an .
pairs.english: In English, a is the indefinite article, with the alternative form an.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: " Stealin' Love " un kanta ginen i kantadot yan kompositor Ingles as Leigh-Anne .
pairs.english: "Stealin' Love" is a song by English singer and songwriter Leigh-Anne.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ma na'huyong gi diha 28 gi i mes Marso 2024 ginen Warner Records komo i fine'nina na kanta ginen i fine'nina na kanta-ña, No Hard Feelings . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ]
pairs.english: It was released on 28 March 2024 through Warner Records as the lead single from her debut extended play, No Hard Feelings.[1][2][3]

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I kantadot yan kompositor jazz giya Amerika as Billie Holiday gi iya New York City gi 1947
pairs.english: American jazz singer and songwriter Billie Holiday in New York City in 1947

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I kanta un komposision musikåt ni' ma cho'gue ni' i bos taotao .
pairs.english: A song is a musical composition performed by the human voice.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I bos ha na'guaha i melodia (un series ni' diferentes yan fihu na tono siha) ni' ha usa i håfa na siñat yan i silensiu.
pairs.english: The voice often carries the melody (a series of distinct and fixed pitches) using patterns of sound and silence.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaha estruktura- ña i kanta siha, taiguihi i ABA form, ya ma fa'tinas ginen seksion siha ni' ma ripiti pat ma cho'gue yan diferentes despues.
pairs.english: Songs have a structure to them, such as the common ABA form, and are usually made of sections that are repeated or performed with variation later.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I kanta ni' taya ' inestrutmento-ña, ma'a'agang a cappella .
pairs.english: A song without instruments is said to be a cappella.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I Sadog Ohio 981-mile-long (1,579 km) na hånom gi i Estådos Unidos .
pairs.english: The Ohio River is a 981-mile-long (1,579 km) river in the United States.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaige gi i sanlagu na bandan i Midwestern yan i Southern United States, ya ha laknos gi i sanlagu na direksion ginen i sanlagu na Pennsylvania asta i pachot-ña gi i Mississippi River gi i sanlagu na puntan Illinois .
pairs.english: It is located at the boundary of the Midwestern and Southern United States, flowing in a southwesterly direction from western Pennsylvania to its mouth on the Mississippi River at the southern tip of Illinois.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guiya i mina'tres na mås takhilo' na hånom gi i Estådos Unidos yan i mas takhilo' na hånom gi i sanlagu-sanhaya na hånom Mississippi, ni' ha dibidi i sanhaya yan sanlichan i Estådos Unidos. [ 1 ] Guiya lokkue' i mina'sais na mås amko' na hånom gi i sanlagu na tåno'.
pairs.english: It is the third largest river by discharge volume in the United States and the largest tributary by volume of the north-south flowing Mississippi River, which divides the eastern from western United States.[1] It is also the sixth oldest river on the North American continent.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I hånom ha laknos gi i sanlagu gi i sais na estados, ya i hånom-ña ha na'halom 14 na estados.
pairs.english: The river flows through or along the border of six states, and its drainage basin includes parts of 14 states.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gi i mas takhilo' na hånom-ña, i Tennessee River, i basin ha na'halom meggai na estados gi sanlagu na båndan i Estådos Unidos. Guiya i fuetsan hånom para singko miyon na taotao. [ 2 ]
pairs.english: Through its largest tributary, the Tennessee River, the basin includes several states of the southeastern U.S. It is the source of drinking water for five million people.[2]

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I Norderney (Nördernee gi fino' CHamoru) unu gi i siete na songsong gi i Islas Frisian Oriental gi i sanlagu na båndan Alemania.
pairs.english: Norderney (German pronunciation: [ˌnɔʁdɐˈnaɪ̯] ⓘ; Low German: Nördernee) is one of the seven populated East Frisian Islands off the North Sea coast of Germany.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I isla 14 gi 2.5 kilumetro (8.7 gi 1.6 mi), yan guaha 26.3 kilumetro kuadrao (10.2 sq mi) ya put este na rason i nuebi na mas takhilo' na isla giya Alemania.
pairs.english: The island is 14 by 2.5 kilometres (8.7 by 1.6 mi), having a total area of about 26.3 square kilometres (10.2 sq mi) and is therefore Germany's ninth-largest island.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I numeron taotao gi iya Norderney guaha 5,850 na taotao.
pairs.english: Norderney's population amounts to about 5,850[3] people.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gi 1946, i Norderney ha risibi i estao-ña gi i munisipåt ya gaige gi i Aurich "Kreis" (county).
pairs.english: In 1946 Norderney gained municipal status and belongs to the Aurich "Kreis" (county).

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gi i sanhaya na bandan i isla guaha 14-kilumetro (8.7 mi) na kanton tasi.
pairs.english: On the northern side of the island lies a 14-kilometre (8.7 mi) long sandy beach.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: "Landesamt für Statistik Niedersachsen."
pairs.english: Landesamt für Statistik Niedersachsen. ↑ "Zensusdatenbank - Ergebnisse des Zensus 2011". ergebnisse.zensus2011.de. Retrieved 2016-11-24. ↑ "World Meteorological Organization Climate Normals for 1991–2010". World Meteorological Organization Climatological Standard Normals (1991–2020).

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I Saddok Mariana (Mariana Trench) un ' gaige gi sanlichan na Tasin Pasifiku, kåsi 200 kilometres (124 mi) este na islas Marianas ; este i mas takhilo ' na trinchera gi i tano'.
pairs.english: The Mariana Trench is an oceanic trench located in the western Pacific Ocean, about 200 kilometres (124 mi) east of the Mariana Islands; it is the deepest oceanic trench on Earth.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I åpaka' na åpaka'-ña ya guaha 2,550 km, 69 km, gi i lina'la'-ña.
pairs.english: It is crescent-shaped and measures about 2,550 km (1,580 mi) in length and 69 km (43 mi) in width.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I mas takhilo' na prodokto ni' ma tungo', 10,984 ± 25 metros; gi i sanlagu na puntan un dikike' na tåno' gi i sagan-ña ni' ma tungo' komu i Challenger Deep . [1] I mas takhilo' na punto gi i trinchera mas ki (2 km) mas tåtte gi i tasi ki i puntan Mount Everest . [ un ]
pairs.english: The maximum known depth is 10,984 ± 25 metres (36,037 ± 82 ft; 6,006 ± 14 fathoms; 6.825 ± 0.016 mi) at the southern end of a small slot-shaped valley in its floor known as the Challenger Deep.[1] The deepest point of the trench is more than 2 km (1.2 mi) farther from sea level than the peak of Mount Everest.[a]

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Historia i sistematiku na inestudia put i pasado, este i manmaloffan na tiempo.
pairs.english: History is the systematic study of the past, focusing primarily on the human past.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Komo un disiplina akademiku, ti mananálisis yan interpreta i ebidensia para u mafa’maolek istoria siha put i mafa’tinas i kosas yan para u maesplica sa’ tatkumi mafa’tinas.
pairs.english: As an academic discipline, it analyses and interprets evidence to construct narratives about what happened and explain why it happened.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaha teorista siha ni’ ma’na’guaha i historia komo un sien­sia sosiát, ennao siha ha’ otro siha ha’li’i’ komo parte i humanidát, pat ha’na’guaha komo un disiplina mesklao.
pairs.english: Some theorists categorize history as a social science, while others see it as part of the humanities or consider it a hybrid discipline.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaha parehu na diskusión siha ni’ kumubre i propositu i historia — pot ehemplu, pat i prinsipat na meteña-ña teorétiku, para u ma’otñi i bérdat, pat praktiku, para u ma’aprendi leksion siha ginen i pasado.
pairs.english: Similar debates surround the purpose of history—for example, whether its main aim is theoretical, to uncover the truth, or practical, to learn lessons from the past.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gi mas jenerál na sinetido, i témino na historia ti ha’li’i’ un kampu akademiku, lao i pasado ha’, i manmaloffan na tiempo, pat i espesífiku na teksu siha ni’ kumubre i pasado.
pairs.english: In a more general sense, the term history refers not to an academic field but to the past itself, times in the past, or to individual texts about the past.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I estúdian historiku ma’usa i primáriu yan sekundáriu na fuenti siha para u mafa’nafåli’i’ i mafa’tinas i pasado yan para u ma’prueba i interpretasion siha.
pairs.english: Historical research relies on primary and secondary sources to reconstruct past events and validate interpretations.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I kritikan fuenti ma’usa para u ma’fåñaina estos na fuenti siha, ni’ ma’a’atan i autentisidát, i contenido, yan i konfiansa-ña.
pairs.english: Source criticism is used to evaluate these sources, assessing their authenticity, content, and reliability.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I manhistoriku siha ha’na’lalåhe para u ma’na’halom i perspektiba siha ginen varios na fuenti siha para u ma’fa’maolek un koherénte na istoria.
pairs.english: Historians strive to integrate the perspectives of several sources to develop a coherent narrative.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I diferente na eskuela siha i pinensan, komu i positibismu, i eskuela Annales, i Marksismu, yan i postmodernismu, guaha distinto na métodu siha gi i metodolohia-ñiha.
pairs.english: Different schools of thought, such as positivism, the Annales school, Marxism, and postmodernism, have distinct methodological approaches.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I historia un anchi na disiplina ni’ kumukubre meggai na ramas siha.
pairs.english: History is a broad discipline encompassing many branches.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaha na’guaha ni’ manfokus gi espesífiku na periodu siha gi tiempo, komu i historia antíguo, mentras otro siha mankonsetra gi espesífiku na rehion heograpiku siha, komu i historia i África.
pairs.english: Some focus on specific time periods, such as ancient history, while others concentrate on particular geographic regions, such as the history of Africa.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I kategorizasion temátiku siha inklusi i historia politiku, i historia militát, i historia sosiat, yan i historia ekonómiku.
pairs.english: Thematic categorizations include political history, military history, social history, and economic history.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I ramas siha ni’ ma’assosiá yan espesífiku na métodu yan fuenti i estúdian inklusi i historia kuantitátibu, i historia komparátibu, yan i historia oral.
pairs.english: Branches associated with specific research methods and sources include quantitative history, comparative history, and oral history.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I historia guinaha’ na’guaha komo un kampu inestigasion gi i antigüedát para u masuplanta i istoria siha ni’ manma’na’halom mitu, yan guaha inpluénsia na priméru na tradision siha ni’ guinaha’ ginen i Grésia, i Chaina, yan dispues gi i mundo Islámiku.
pairs.english: History emerged as a field of inquiry in antiquity to replace myth-infused narratives, with influential early traditions originating in Greece, China, and later in the Islamic world.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I istorian esturia guinaha’ chule’ lina’la’ throughout i edat siha yan guinaha’ na’guaha mas profesionál, espesialmente gi i siglu diesnuebe, ania’ guinaha’ na’guaha un rigurósu na metodolohia yan varios na institusion akademiku siha.
pairs.english: Historical writing evolved throughout the ages and became increasingly professional, particularly during the 19th century, when a rigorous methodology and various academic institutions were established.

pairs.attribution: wikimedia contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: I historia ta’na’halom yan meggai na otro na kampu siha, komu i historiografia, i pilosofía, i edukasion, yan i politiku.
pairs.english: History is related to many fields, including historiography, philosophy, education, and politics.
